faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) for various project-based research positions under an ICMR funded project.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available across various posts including Project Research Scientist-I (Medical), Project Technical Support-II (PTS), and Project Technical Support-I (PTS).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 28-09-2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated email address prior to this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The applications for AIIMS Delhi recruitment must be submitted via Email to [email protected] with the specified subject line as detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post must possess an MBBS, BDS, MVSc or equivalent degree from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 87,100 per month, which includes Rs. 67,000 plus HRA at 30%.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any age limits for AIIMS Delhi PTS posts?
faq.answer: Yes, the maximum age limit is 35 years for Scientist-I, 30 years for Project Technical Support-II, and 28 years for Project Technical Support-I.

faq.question: Q8. What is the interview date for AIIMS Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in or interview date for the shortlisted candidates has been scheduled for 8 October 2026, as per the official recruitment timeline.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Delhi posts?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for any of the categories applying for AIIMS Delhi Project positions.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the AIIMS Delhi notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by navigating to the Important Links section of this article and clicking on the designated notification link.
